reuse.why: It reuses the existing applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay/WeekendRule abstraction for moving dates and extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend for holidays, but the daily-skip case is handled outside that abstraction at every call site.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && frequency === daily' test and the filter-out-weekend-or-holiday logic are repeated in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template, and getDatesInRange re-assembles the config-to-WeekendRule mapping already written in getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Holiday detection and moving live correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip policy is decided in server handlers and the budget template instead of in the shared weekend rule.

scope.why: Changes track the four steps (daily skip, range handler, holidays, MM-DD holidays) with tests and release notes; nothing unrelated, though four release-note files for one feature thread is a little noisy.

maintainability.why: Four separately maintained daily-skip branches with ad-hoc lookahead heuristics (take 7 + holidays*7, margin 3 + holidays.length) plus the inverted '!isDaily' noSkipWeekend argument in schedule-template make the weekend behaviour hard to reason about and easy to desynchronise.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts branch around applyWeekendRule with their own isWeekendOrHoliday filter for daily schedules; schedule-template.ts forces skipWeekend false and flips getNextDate's noSkipWeekend flag for daily schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily weekend/holiday skip is reshaped at each site (filter+take in getNextDate, filter+slice in getUpcomingDates, continue-in-loop in getDatesInRange) rather than shared through the WeekendRule abstraction.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gained a holidays field and getDateWithSkippedWeekend a holidays parameter; the daily-skip case never entered the shared rule, so getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template.ts each bypass applyWeekendRule for daily schedules (getNextDate also adds its own skipsWeekendDays branch).
